newsitem.title: UK: Shield gains amid upbeat press comment.
newsitem.headline: Shield gains amid upbeat press comment.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc rose sharply for a third day on Tuesday after upbeat comment in the Daily Mail newspaper, dealers said.

After the biotechnology group soared on Monday after Shield released clinical trial data on the effectiveness of its heart attack test, the Mail said the test alone could put a value of 21.00 stg on the stock.

The stock was up 42-1/2p at 732-1/2 by 0917 GMT in volume of 202,329 shares -- moving back towards its record 928p set March 14. The stock began a dramatic rise in early February, when it was trading below 170p.

The Mail said if Shield won just a 10 percent market share of the heart disease test market, and makes a profit of 50p a test, it would make pre-tax profits of 40 million stg a year -- putting a value of some 400 million stg on the company.
On Monday the company said studies showed that patients with coronary heart disease had 30 percent higher levels of clotting agent called AFT, for which it has developed the only known test.
Shield believes the test is more accurate than the 500 million stg worth of cholesterol tests taken each year.
